title: Noibat PokeBall Pattern Reverse Holo Common SV: Prismatic Evolutions 090/131
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Noibat PokeBall Pattern Reverse Holo Common card from the SV: Prismatic Evolutions set is a collectible card game item manufactured by The Pokemon Company in the United States. With a standard card size and illustrated by Masako Tomii, this English-language card features a colorless Noibat character in a reverse holofoil finish. As part of the Pokemon TCG, this rare card is a valuable addition for collectors and players alike.
